requirements.requirement: Use original Mendeley data; do not create synthetic patient data

requirements.notes: Target mapping yes=missed, no=attended. Raw-age timing inconsistency corrected by deriving historical age locally; dates of birth excluded from model inputs and release.

requirements.requirement: Use only predictors available before appointments; document feature availability and exclusions
requirements.notes: Allowlisted age, specialty, derived scheduled hour/weekday/month. Outcome reasons and observed weather excluded. Availability of historical scheduling snapshots remains an explicit assumption.

requirements.requirement: Handle repeated people / patient linkage honestly
requirements.notes: No reusable patient identifier exists; no invented history, linkage, unseen-patient generalization, or patient-cluster confidence-interval claim.

requirements.requirement: Train real constant baseline, scikit-learn logistic, HistGradientBoosting, and PyTorch two-hidden-layer model
requirements.notes: Saved trained finite weights and sklearn fitted-model properties verified; every model produces reproducible numerical inference.

requirements.requirement: Save and reuse training-fitted preprocessing with trained artifacts
requirements.notes: Single, batch and reload inference within 1e-6 on all four models; artifact checksums and safe format/type restrictions pass.

requirements.requirement: Select default on development evidence, without assuming neural model wins
requirements.notes: Default logistic chosen by validation AP with log-loss/name tie breaks. Resource/reliability evidence should be read alongside selection; no effectiveness claim.

requirements.requirement: Held-out AP/ROC/precision/recall/F1/confusion metrics and probability reliability

requirements.requirement: Supported subgroup results, uncertainty and limitations
